messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding cascade-12b (quantized build) is causing CI failures in the eval runner. Some prompts are getting different token splits vs the float baseline and it changes answer-length metrics. anyone seen this?

chao: Saw the failures this morning. Mostly answer-length and rouge-like metrics drifting. Token counts differ by 2-5 tokens on the same prompt for many samples.

sam: can you paste a failing example?

maya: here's one minimal repro and token dumps from both tokenizers:

```
prompt: "User: summarize the release notes — include highlights, risks, and migration notes.
System: You are concise.
"
baseline tokens: [1012, 456, 78, 9001, 999] -> count 21
quant tokens:    [1012, 456, 78, 9001, 0, 999] -> count 22

Notice the extra 0 token inserted around the em-dash char.
```

devops-bot: CI job #247 failed: eval-runner/runner-03 — exit code 2 (tokenizer mismatch)

chao: That looks like a variant of an encoding/BPE mismatch. The q4f-compiled tokenizer binary we shipped has a different mapping for 0xE2 0x80 0x94 (em dash) -> introduces an extra sentinel token when normalization isn't applied.

nora: is this related to the padding/tokenizer changes we hit with nova earlier? Different root cause but similar symptom surface (unexpected extra tokens).

maya: I instrumented the runner to dump pre-tokenizer input and post-tokenizer ids. Repro command: 

```bash
python -m eval_runner.dump_tokens \
  --model cascade-12b \
  --input tests/fixtures/failing_prompts.txt \
  --out /tmp/cascade_token_dumps.json
```

sample dump: 

```json
{
  "input": "summarize the release notes — include highlights",
  "pre_bytes": [115,101,114, ... 226,128,148, ...],
  "post_ids": [1012,456,78,9001,0,999]
}
```

sam: quick local hack: forcing utf-8 normalization in tokenizer init fixed the extra 0 for me (`tokenizer = Tok(..., normalize_utf8=True)`). But our CI image has tokenlib wheel 1.3.0 which doesn't include normalizer fixes.

chao: Actionable items: add a unit in eval-harness asserting token-count stability across float vs quant variants for a small canonical prompt set; add a runner fallback to rerun on float model if token delta > threshold and mark the eval as inconclusive. Also we should pin tokenlib to 1.4.2 in CI image.

maya: I'll open a PR to add the token-consistency tests + bump tokenlib in the CI image. Also adding a fallback flag (`--rerun-on-token-delta`) to the runner that defaults off but can be enabled for the onboarding pipeline.

nora: :thumbsup: timeline?

maya: PR in ~2h. Target to roll CI image patch tonight. I'll also deploy the runner fallback to the onboarding namespace this afternoon so new runs don't flood SRE.

chao: Note: we also observed subtle template-preserve issues — chat templates that inject system prefixes can shift counts differently between tokenizers. Add tests that snapshot full rendered template bytes before tokenization.

sam: I'll add a nightly jenkins job to run the token-consistency suite across latest quant builds and publish a small dashboard.

maya: Thanks. tagging @eng-oncall in case CI noise spikes or we need to throttle runs.

chao: Good plan. Once the CI image is pinned we should re-run the last failing job to see if drift disappears.

maya: Will do. If anyone finds related failing prompts, drop them in this thread and I'll add to the repro set.
